summary:
AMD 2026年第二季營收年增逾五成，每股盈餘優於預期，資料中心與AI晶片業務動能強勁。
• 第二季營收達 115.4 億美元，年增 50.11%。
• 每股盈餘 (EPS) 實際達 1.66 美元，高於市場預期的 1.61 美元。
• 資料中心部門持續受惠於企業端強勁的 AI 晶片需求。
• 毛利率維持健康水準，顯示高階產品定價能力穩固。
ai_view:
觀點：本季財報展現強勁的營收與獲利超預期，證明 AMD 在 AI 基礎設施市場的擴張步伐穩健。對中短期股價而言，這為多頭提供基本面支撐，但高達 131 倍的本益比意味著市場對其成長有極高定價。後續應密切追蹤資料中心毛利率變化、供應鏈產能瓶頸以及 MI300/MI325 等系列產品對微軟、Meta 等大型雲端客戶的實際出貨與市佔率表現。

需留意：高達 131.65 的本益比顯示市場已預先織入高度成長期望，評價面容錯率低。；半導體供應鏈成本上升及同業競爭可能侵蝕未來利潤率。

summary_en:
AMD reported Q2 2026 revenue growth of over 50% YoY and beat EPS estimates, driven by strong momentum in data center and AI chips.
• Q2 revenue reached $11.54B, representing a 50.11% YoY increase.
• Actual EPS came in at $1.66, beating the estimated $1.61.
• Data center segment continued to benefit from robust enterprise AI chip demand.
• Gross margins remained healthy, reflecting solid pricing power in high-end products.

ai_view_en:
View: The earnings beat demonstrates AMD's steady expansion in the AI infrastructure market, providing fundamental support for the stock. However, a trailing PE above 130 implies perfection is priced in. Key metrics to monitor include data center gross margins, supply chain capacity, and actual shipment volumes and market share of the MI300 and MI325 series to major cloud hyperscalers.

Watch：A high trailing PE of 131.65 indicates lofty growth expectations are already priced in, leaving little room for error.; Rising supply chain costs and intense competition could pressure future profit margins.
beat_or_miss: 超預期，營收與每股盈餘皆優於市場平均預期。
